Detail.document_description: A technical document that provides detailed information about a product, including specifications, features, and usage instructions

schema_fields.name: product_name
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and extract the full name of the product as it appears in the manual.

schema_fields.name: brand
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and extract the brand or manufacturer name of the product.

schema_fields.name: model_number
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and extract the model number or product code.

schema_fields.name: description
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and provide a comprehensive summary of the product, including its purpose and main features.

schema_fields.name: features
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and extract a list of key product features and benefits.

schema_fields.name: dimensions
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and extract the physical dimensions of the product (length, width, height).

schema_fields.name: weight
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and extract the weight of the product.

schema_fields.name: power_requirements
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and extract the power requirements (voltage, wattage).

schema_fields.name: materials
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and extract information about materials used in the product.

schema_fields.name: connectivity
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and extract information about connectivity options (WiFi, Bluetooth, etc.).

schema_fields.name: additional_specs
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and extract any additional specifications not covered by other fields.

schema_fields.name: usage_instructions
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and provide a brief summary of how to use the product.

schema_fields.name: warranty_info
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and extract a summary of warranty information.

schema_fields.name: categories
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and identify product categories this item belongs to.

schema_fields.name: keywords
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and suggest relevant search terms for the product.

schema_fields.name: target_audience
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and identify the intended audience or users of the product.

schema_fields.name: release_date
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and extract when the product was released or manufactured.

schema_fields.name: comparison_table
schema_fields.description: Please analyze the following product manual and extract any comparison tables between product models or features. Include the feature being compared, the value or specification for this product, and any additional notes or context.
